'''Prodigal-Two''' was the codename for [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] pilot [[Kala Kevv]]'s [[Dataplaque/Legends|data plaque]]. He and the card were rescued during [[Operation: Shadowstrike]].
